visualCharacteristics.description: Centre-mode strip of ~5 square white tiles (photo + linked uppercase company name); centre tile enlarged with a shadow, neighbours step down; active slide caption (person name) below; round edge arrows and dots. Circular, no auto-rotation.

contentPattern.description: 1 row per slide: [square image (optionally linked) | linked company-name paragraph + optional person-name caption paragraph]. Caption shows below the strip for the centred slide.
contentPattern.structure: 1 row per slide: [square image | linked title paragraph + caption paragraph]
